description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Fragment, responsible for displaying log messages in a scrollable view within an Android application. It includes methods to inflate and set up the views, configure styling, and handle text changes to scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays logs in a scrollable TextView (LogView). It manages view creation, styling, and ensures the log scrolls to the bottom when new text is added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, padding, and adding the LogView to the ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout by calling inflateViews(), adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
